elements.description:
Organization-level data handling as a lifecycle – conversations, logs, memory, training, deletion – led by the policy
in effect, each stage edited in place, locked stages marked, and deletion requests with their status.

properties.name: value
properties.default: { retention: "30d", memory: "conversation", logging: "metadata", redact: ["personal", "financial", "credentials"], training: false }
properties.description: The chosen policy. Changed by the user unless a tc-value-change listener calls preventDefault()

properties.name: effective
properties.description: The policy the app reports as applied; a missing field reads "Not reported"

properties.name: locks
properties.description: Settings fixed higher up; they can't be edited here and say who set them

properties.name: retentionOptions
properties.default: [ { id: "7d", label: "7 days" }, { id: "30d", label: "30 days" }, { id: "90d", label: "90 days" }, { id: "1y", label: "1 year" }, { id: "forever", label: "Until deleted" }, ]
properties.description: How long conversations can be kept

properties.name: memoryOptions
properties.default: [ { id: "off", label: "Off", description: "Nothing is remembered between messages beyond the conversation itself." }, { id: "conversation", label: "This conversation", description: "Remembered facts are forgotten when the conversation ends." }, { id: "persistent", label: "Across conversations", description: "Remembered facts are kept until someone deletes them." }, ]

properties.name: loggingOptions
properties.default: [ { id: "off", label: "Off", description: "Nothing is logged." }, { id: "metadata", label: "Metadata", description: "Timing, model and token counts – no message content." }, { id: "content", label: "Full content", description: "Messages and responses, with the categories below redacted." }, ]

properties.name: categories
properties.default: [ { id: "personal", label: "Personal details", description: "Names, email addresses, phone numbers" }, { id: "financial", label: "Payment details", description: "Card and bank account numbers" }, { id: "credentials", label: "Credentials", description: "Passwords, keys and tokens" }, { id: "health", label: "Health information", description: "Conditions, treatments, records" }, ]
properties.description: The kinds of data that can be redacted from logs

properties.name: deletionScopes
properties.default: [ { id: "conversations", label: "Conversations", description: "Every conversation and its attachments." }, { id: "memory", label: "Memory", description: "Everything remembered across conversations." }, { id: "logs", label: "Logs", description: "Logged messages and metadata." }, ]
properties.description: What a deletion request can cover; empty hides Request deletion

properties.name: deletions
properties.description: Deletion requests and their status, as the app reports them

properties.name: labels
properties.description: The stages' and settings' names, merged over the defaults (Conversations, Logs, Memory, Training, Redact from logs)

properties.name: description
properties.description: A quieter line under the heading, e.g. which workspace this is

properties.name: trainingLabel
properties.default: "Allow conversations to be used to train models"

properties.name: organization
properties.description: Who a lock without `by` was set by

properties.name: deletionNote
properties.default: "Deletion can't be undone. It can take a while; the request's status shows here."
properties.description: Said in the deletion dialog, under the scope

properties.name: name
properties.description: Submitted with the form: the policy as JSON

properties.name: disabled
properties.description: Turns every control off and leaves the policy out of the form; a disabled fieldset does the same

properties.name: look
properties.description: Visual style: "standard" or "clean"; unset follows <tc-look-provider>, else "standard"

events.name: tc-value-change
events.description: A setting changed ({ value, field }: DataPolicyChange); cancelable – prevent it to control `value`

events.name: tc-deletion-request
events.description: A deletion was confirmed ({ scope }: DataPolicyDeletionEvent); cancelable – prevented, no pending request is shown

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The policy to start with when uncontrolled

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called with the whole policy and the setting that changed, after every change

props.name: onDeletionRequest
props.description: A deletion was confirmed: send the request. Call `event.preventDefault()` if it can't be sent, so no pending request shows
